decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution builds directly on the firm's aviation security and data know-how, and its quantified results (UK Home Office E-borders use and over 30 government APIS connections) give the firm clear feedback it can absorb and use to improve the product.

The behaviour analysis system extends the firm's established behavioural detection expertise and certified training base, so it has the related knowledge to refine the product even though the website gives it little visibility and no quantified results.

The passenger profiling method rests on the firm's core screening and profiling methodology and its operational experience at airports, so the firm can interpret early results and keep developing it despite limited public evidence.

The travel and document verification platform is close to the firm's document-check services for airlines and complements Product A, which lets the firm readily assimilate market feedback and apply it commercially.
